name: pikku-site-archaeology
description: Study an existing website before rebuilding it: crawl every page and write down the screens, what every form and button does and what it stores, prices, currency, languages and outside services, as plain notes in knowledge/site/ for a person to review. Use before planning a clone, rebuild or conversion of a live site. Page layout and look is pikku-site-clone.

findings.excerpt: mkdir -p artifacts/references/<site> && pikku ui pages capture https://the-site.example/ --out artifacts/references/<site> > artifacts/references/<site>/capture
there is no browser, fetch each page with `curl -sL` and read the text.
